name: Chain Reaction
design_intent:
PHYSICS-LAB circuit 4 CAPSTONE (course 4 of 4): every lab tool in one run — a rideable cannon OVER a recurring-bomb field (or the timed gauntlet THROUGH it), ending in a dive that SMASHES a crate roof to DROP into a sealed goal chamber reachable ONLY from above. ENTITY-VERIFIED DESIGN CONSTRAINT: bombs do NOT damage destructible_blocks — DestructibleBlock.gd only takes hp from PLAYER contacts ('hit' >=300px/s, 'smash' = super_active or >=900px/s), and Bomb.gd's blast kills players / Forces-punts impulsable bodies / punts the sports ball, never touching block hp. So the owner's 'explode a path open' fantasy is delivered honestly: bombs gate the ROUTE (timing hazard), the PLAYER's own impact is the only demolition charge — the finale is you AS the projectile breaking the floor in.

BALLISTIC DERIVATION (gravity 1600, impulse 2600, muzzle = pivot + 230): cannon pivot (650,560), FIXED -50 deg. Muzzle = (798, 384). Launch v = (1672, -1992). Apex = 1992^2/3200 = 1240px above the muzzle -> apex y = -856 (bounds top -1300 clears by ~440). Landing on the high approach pad top y=700 (316px below the muzzle): solve 800t^2 - 1992t - 316 = 0 -> t = 2.64s, x = 798 + 1672*2.64 = 5209 — ~410px in from the left edge of the approach pad (x4800-5600, w800 trampoline). Landing vx 1672: boost-tap brake (boost_enter_keep 0.25) or let the trampoline skip carry you toward the chamber side. BOMB SAFETY OF THE FLIGHT: at x=1800 (first bomb) the arc is at y=-523, i.e. ~1550px above the bomb line (y1030) — over 4x the 320px blast radius. The ride is untouchable.

THE LOW GAUNTLET (the alternative for the fuel-brave): four trampoline pads at y1150 (x1300/2300/3300/4300, w260) under three RECURRING fuse bombs at y1030 (x1800: fuse 2.2s recur 3.6; x2800: fuse 3.0s recur 4.2; x3800: fuse 2.6s recur 3.9 — deliberately co-prime-ish cycles so the field never syncs into one safe metronome). Bomb geometry per Bomb.gd: blast_radius 320 (knockback), inner kill_radius default 0.6*320 = 192, telegraph_lead 1.1s of accelerating blink + the exact-radius ring. Pad centers sit 665-735px from the nearest bomb center — OUTSIDE blast radius, so a player ON a pad is never killed or even shoved: only the CROSSINGS are exposed, and each crossing has the 1.1s ring to read. Gaps: start pad (ends x400) -> 1300 = 900px; then 740px pad-to-pad — every gap > spring drift ~527 -> a BOOST leg apiece, +20 fuel per pad touch. Gauntlet exit: last pad (4300-4560, y1150) -> approach pad (4800, y700): 450px climb > spring 480? No — 450 < 480 but there is no spring here, only trampoline (270) -> BOOST climb.

THE SEALED CHAMBER (goal only-from-above, verified geometry): bumper walls x5900-6000 and x6660-6760 (y740-1300), bumper floor x6000-6660 (y1240-1320), and a destructible ROOF x6000-6660 (y740-840, break_on SMASH hp1) sitting flush between the wall tops — no side or bottom seam; the roof is the single way in. Breaking it: plain boost (760) can never smash (INV-1, gate 900); the tools are (a) THE DIVE — climb ~400px above the roof and free-fall: impact = sqrt(2*1600*390) = 1117px/s >= 900 (253px of fall is the exact 900 threshold; the course gives ~390), costs zero fuel, or (b) a downward SUPER (2800, dumps tank, min 5 fuel). The roof cracks 0.28s and vanishes; you drop into the 660x400 chamber onto the goal_gate (center 6330,1040, w280 h300). Gap approach pad (ends 5600) -> roof (starts 6000): 400px > trampoline drift ~395 -> boost hop, then climb-and-dive.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (flight required — capstone, so every verb appears):
- Load the cannon: capture r70 @ (650,560) is 440px above the start pad top (1000) > trampoline 270 -> BOOST.
- Cannon route: 4400px of void crossed by the RIDE (tank range ~2660px at 760px/s could never do it in one line).
- Gauntlet route: 900px + 3x740px gaps, all > spring drift 527 -> BOOST every leg, timed against the bomb rings; exit climb 450px -> BOOST.
- Approach -> roof: 400px gap -> BOOST hop; then the DIVE (>=253px fall) or SUPER to break in.
Zero legs are bounce-crossable; the finale is uncompletable without a smash-grade impact.

FUEL BUDGET: cannon route: ~25 to load, flight free, brake ~5, hop+climb+dive ~20 — finishes with half a tank untouched. Gauntlet: 4 boost legs ~28 each vs +20 per touch (net ~-8/leg) + exit climb ~25 -> arrives at the approach pad around 40-55 even after a dodge-hover; the dive finale costs nothing, so a dry-ish tank still finishes. Spawn (200,900) is 1600px from the nearest bomb (5x blast radius) — SAFE; a blast knockback near a pad is survivable (boost recovery sky: pads y1150 -> void lip y1400), a kill/fall is a free respawn at start; the roof STAYS broken across respawns (in-run persistence), so the ending never re-tolls.

FAIRNESS: bombs telegraph 1.1s with the exact lethal ring and recur on visible cycles; the roof telegraphs cracks; walls/floor are bumpers (never lethal — the void stays the only killer); explicit bounds: top -1300 clears the -856 arc apex, right 7100 fences the chamber, bottom 2000 under the void lip at 1400.
hint: RIDE THE CANNON — DIVE THROUGH THE ROOF
